heading: Monday, June 29, 2026
topLine: Machine-learning screening leads to two new kagome superconductors made at Rice.

items.headline: Machine-learning screening leads to two new kagome superconductors made at Rice
items.summary: Aalto University's Paivi Torma and the SuperC consortium used machine-learning pre-screening plus targeted quantum calculations to pick candidate superconductors, and Emilia Morosan's group at Rice synthesised and measured them, confirming bulk superconductivity in YRu3B2 and LuRu3B2 at 0.81 K and 0.95 K. Published in Physical Review Research as a proof of concept for a pipeline the consortium hopes can scale to thousands of candidates; the critical temperatures are far below room temperature.
